key_insight: The paper proposes that coherent magnons enable nuclear resonance energy transfer while avoiding the mass dilution and spin cancellation that constrain phonon-mediated transfer.
engineering_relevance: If validated, this mechanism could shift metal-deuteride energy-transfer designs away from lattice-strain pathways constrained by fracture toward magnetically driven coupling.
method: Extend the generalized nuclear Dicke model to ferromagnetic-resonance magnons.
Model hyperfine-amplified M1 coupling and polarization-enabled relativistic M2 coupling.
Derive a Suhl-clamped ferromagnetic-resonance scaling law.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical predictions of 14.2 MeV and 11.4 MeV breakup neutrons and 19.9 MeV alpha particles, but provides no experimental validation or quantitative evaluation of its claimed reconciliation of sub-keV fusion anomalies.
watch_item: Achieving the required magnon coherence and nuclear spin polarization under realistic damping and instability limits remains an implementation concern.
paper_title: Macroscopic Nuclear Resonance Energy Transfer Mediated by Coherent Magnons
